summary: Scope 02 groundwork only: the development-only bake-session crate's Session restoration, replay and request derivation, released-format migrations, projections (usage, pressure, inbox, goal, subagent, boundary), unfinished work, fork seeds, prompt admission, and restored request derivation, compared with TypeScript through 36 shared case tables (3303 cases) and three runtime captures. A clean checkout of candidate e9e1e55034338bc4a521cd18d1a2a857bc2b9268 passed 461 workspace Cargo tests and 4079 Vitest tests (4 skipped) in the 40 TypeScript specs that read those tables. CI for PR #134 tested synthetic merge cc348b8494ce16fad9465cef987a7c7d586ce11e, which has the candidate's tree a6f38828bd3fd7527f8b17c92a5911566193e8be. One shared-table control was rejected by both harnesses. Native-limit refusals are not parity; children's own logs, migrated and Zstd unfinished work, Agent resume, and full preflight are missing. Not scope acceptance.

results.behavior: All 40 TypeScript specs under packages/ that read a conformance/session or conformance/runtime table passed: 4079 Vitest tests passed and 4 skipped (four win32-only lookup cases on this POSIX host). Counts describe Vitest tests across 40 files, not table cases.

cargo test --workspace --locked passed 461 tests across 53 test targets (4 doc-test targets ran none). bake-session contributed 128: 59 unit tests and 69 integration tests in 34 binaries, most of which iterate a whole shared table inside one test, so counts describe Cargo tests, not cases. Formatting, clippy, and rustdoc were not run for this record.

On PR #134 synthetic merge (candidate tree), native preflight passed 5 gates on Linux and macOS (rust, rust-pty, rust-conformance, rust-eval, rust-lease) and 4 on Windows with rust-pty skipped (ConPTY scenarios not implemented). Counts describe gates.

The rust jobs then ran seven of the 40 conformance specs (lookup, generation-header, stat, list, v2-to-v3 migration, subagent projection and catalog) on each OS: 829 passed and 4 skipped on Linux, 826 and 7 on macOS, 792 and 41 on Windows. Counts describe Vitest tests across those seven files.

App checks with --fast --skip native passed 24 gates and skipped 12 on Linux, including typecheck, lint, verify-persistence-catalog, verify-rust-migration-inventory, and the ledger verifier; whitespace (no merge base) and actionlint were among the skips. Counts describe gates.

PR #134's run had no runtime job. The last runtime job before the candidate, PR #131's (stack top), passed the build, runtime (whole suite, since no merge base was found), and integration gates on Linux at synthetic merge 191a8ba4b385a1448ed843b540fa3d71be54aefe, which differs from the candidate only in AGENTS.md and three docs/roadmap/rust-0.4 files. Counts describe gates.

Several tables carry explicit native-limit refusals (JavaScript coercion, TypeError inputs, float and -0 spellings, fractional restore numbers) that the Rust tests require instead of the TypeScript outcome. This checks refuse-rather-than-guess; it is not parity for those cases.
Local runs of the 40 specs and cargo test on Windows and macOS.

negativeControls.assertion: Both harnesses reject the edited table: Vitest failed only no-system-node-open-turn (35 passed, 1 failed; exit 1) and the Rust shared_cases_admit_prompts_like_the_agent_loop test panicked with "no-system-node-open-turn: content generation" left 0, right 1 (3 passed, 1 failed; exit 101).

missingEvidence.what: Migrated and Zstd logs in unfinished work and prefix restoration
missingEvidence.reason: Unfinished-work and prefix-restoration cases cover plain current-format logs only.
Every primitive is a development-only fold over a restored log; no Agent resumes and no real composed runtime runs, which the verification contract requires for product-visible behavior.
Prompt admission stops before the header-reason, request/context, and tool-update decisions, which stay private to TypeScript request building.
The native-limit refusals across the tables are not yet classified against what D21 permits; that work is in progress and unrecorded here.
Restoration refuses some fractional numbers as a native limit although a released writer can produce them, an open writer-reachable gap under D21; the fix is in progress and unrecorded here.

This record observes one flipped expectation only; it does not record controls for an unknown required event, an invalid reference, and sequence corruption, though some tables contain such refusal cases.
The crash-recovery matrix kill-and-restart cases for scope 02 are not recorded.
No local Windows or macOS host; CI ran native gates on all three and only seven of the 40 specs on each.
No full or fast preflight ran locally; CI on the candidate tree ran native and --fast app checks only, and the runtime suite last ran on PR #131's merge.
